explication: Path of Building 2 Community is an offline Path of Exile 2 build planner. A user edits passive, skill, item, and party configuration through the tabbed UI; those build inputs are combined with game data, evaluated by offence/defence calculators, and rendered as summaries and detailed breakdowns. Import/export and trade search form optional branches. The tree and README establish these capabilities; the sampled files are maintenance scripts, so internal call ownership is shown conservatively at directory/module boundaries.
